# Address

## Summary
Base-realm compound field for a postal address. Lives at
`https://cardstack.com/base/address` (default export `AddressField`).

## API
- `addressLine1`, `addressLine2` — street lines (StringField)
- `city`, `state`, `postalCode`, `poBoxNumber` — StringFields
- `country` — a `CountryField` (`{ name, code }`) with a picker edit UI
- `fullAddress` — computed one-line rendering of the whole address

## Usage
```ts
import AddressField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/address';

@field shippingAddress = contains(AddressField);
```
Embedded format renders the composed address; edit format is a full form
including the country picker.
